snippet.title: Kill The Nova - GamePlay Trailer
snippet.description:
🎯 Wishlist Kill The Nova now!　https://store.steampowered.com/app/4542800/Kill_The_Nova

Classic Puzzle × Roguelike Deckbuilding!

Collect unique pieces, create absurd synergies, and unleash scores so large they stop making sense. Every run is a new opportunity to stack multipliers, break the game, and discover completely overpowered combinations.

Build your strategy from over 150 Special Pieces, modify your deck through powerful Rebuild upgrades, and navigate branching paths filled with bosses, rewards, and impossible decisions.

💥 150+ Special Pieces with endless synergy potential
🧠 Classic puzzle gameplay enhanced by roguelike deckbuilding mechanics
📈 Create ridiculous multiplier chains and astronomical scores
⚙️ Rebuild your pieces to push your strategy even further
👾 Face over 20 unique Prime Cells and survive 7 escalating Ranks
🎵 Retro pixel-art visuals and a dopamine-fueled soundtrack

But there's one final obstacle standing in your way.

At the end of every run awaits Nova—the developer himself.

Take the absurd numbers you've created and throw them directly at his face. Make him regret every balance decision he's ever made.

🔔 Wishlist now and Kill The Nova!

Developed by NQV4 & ProblemEdge

🐦 X: https://x.com/Problem_Edge
💬 Discord: https://discord.com/invite/5Zmw94ucDs
